display.purpose: The page title only; uppercase, balanced.

title.purpose: Step and caption headings; the button face.

figure.purpose: Every actionable number: lane risks, band numerals, verdict figures.

label.purpose: Table heads, tags, band names; under twenty characters.

mono.purpose: Hashes, addresses, code and timestamps; never inputs or prose.

motion.name: swing
motion.purpose: A pin moving to its reading with overshoot, like a meter needle; removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: replay-step
motion.purpose: The archive replay advancing hour by hour.

narrative.overview: Amanat's surface is a reference plate a mariner memorises: a scale down the left with what reaches each band, live readings pinned against it, and one band printed in red where the contract pays. Ivory stock, black ink, chart blue-grey keylines, on a night sea. Depth is made only by flat colour overlapping flat colour; there are no cards, gradients or shadows. Numbers are set in a heavy condensed grotesk and prose in a plain one; red appears exactly once in meaning.
keyCharacteristics: One plate per idea, edge to edge, numbered in its own margin
The scale is the hero: eleven bands, 0.0 at the foot, red from 0.75
Readings are pins on tracks with a needle that swings in
Exactly one red, and it always means the cover pays
Flat colour, 2px ink rules, no radius, no shadow, no gradient
Every figure in the display face with tabular numerals

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red is the trigger and nothing else; a new element may be red only if it means the contract pays or something is wrong.

rules.name: The Overlap Rule
rules.body: Depth is one flat colour over another. No gradient, shadow, blur or tone; a 2px ink rule or a flat band brings a region forward.

rules.name: The Number Rule
rules.body: Every number a reader might act on is set in the display face with tabular numerals.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a heading; a plate's number is marginalia in the top-right corner.

dos: Do put every new idea on its own plate with a 2px ink border and 36px padding.
Do set actionable numbers in Big Shoulders Display 900 and sentences in Archivo.
Do reserve red for the trigger and errors, and tint the top quarter of every track.
Do say what is missing in words: no reading, stale, could not read the archive.
donts: Don't put a label or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't use shadows, gradients, blur, glass, or rounded corners beyond the pin head and the mark.
Don't use monospace for inputs or prose.
Don't render readings as bars, sparklines or rings.
Don't use a card grid, a stats row, or a hero metric.
